beats.title: Merged With Contested Turn-Rate Changes Intact
beats.body: The pull request was merged in late December 2016, including the widened delta limits that nearly doubled the turn-rate ceiling — the very change later criticized by a core maintainer as harming original gameplay feel. Post-merge discussion revealed deep disagreement about whether turn-rate limits are physics (inviolable) or implementation detail (tunable), but no revert was ultimately committed.

beats.title: Engineering Lessons
lessons: Legacy gameplay parameters can masquerade as implementation bugs; distinguishing 'incorrect' from 'intentional but unfamiliar' requires explicit design documentation before changes land.
Merging before all stakeholders have reviewed creates expensive post-merge debates, especially when the contested change touches competitive balance that is nearly impossible to objectively measure.

Exposing historically fixed physics constants as user preferences shifts balance responsibility to players, but in competitive contexts this often advantages whoever optimizes the setting most aggressively.
